invariants_checked: Container security defaults: Docker container creation drops all capabilities (CapDrop=ALL), sets no-new-privileges, enforces PID/memory/CPU limits, avoids host network/privileged mode, and validates host bind-mount paths and symlink targets.

Command & shell script injection safety: dockerExecCommand passes user commands via positional arguments ($1 / $@), ShellQuote escapes shell metacharacters, and ShellJobSubmitScriptWithBackend/shellJobWrapperScript/ShellJobCancelScript validate ValidShellJobID (^sj_[0-9a-f]{4}$) and single-quote paths.

Secret & credential isolation: Cube data-plane INFO logging logs only command lines prior to wrapWithStdin heredoc wrapping and logs credential presence rather than raw tokens; secret_fill encrypts AES-GCM envelopes and cleans temporary material; gatewaySplitTransport sends inbound traffic tokens only to verified gateway targets with SSRF guards.

Cross-tenant & shared-machine session isolation: SessionBoundManager enforces tenant/session/config ownership on bindings, strips client-supplied AttachPID on shared user machines, validates terminal/shell working directories via workspace.CleanWorkDirIn, and protects read-only attachment input trees.

Concurrency, lock ordering, & memory bounds: lifecycle/turn/rewind Redis locks use token-verified compare-and-delete/renew Lua scripts; DockerRemoteClient.streamExec and ReadFile bound buffered stdout/stderr streams to 64 MiB and reject oversize ReadFile streams without host OOM or silent truncation; Redis traffic token patching uses escape-aware JSON key scanning.

GENYEE rebrand & contract alignment: verified com.genyee.sandbox.* labels, GENYEE_* env vars, /var/lib/genyee & /opt/genyee/tenant/skills paths, genyee/genyee-desktop template names, and zero weknora/knora/wk_ residues across all 136 files.

findings.summary: ShellJobSubmitScriptWithBackend, shellJobWrapperScript, and ShellJobCancelScript interpolated job.ID / meta.ID into /bin/sh scripts (using Go %q double-quoting or unquoted path segments) without checking ValidShellJobID, allowing shell command/path injection if a malformed job ID reached script builders.

CubeRemoteClient.Exec wrapped request.Stdin into the shell heredoc command before calling logCubeDataPlaneExec, leaking full plaintext Stdin payloads (including secret material and file contents) into INFO logs.

DockerRemoteClient.streamExec buffered container stdout and stderr into unbounded bytes.Buffers via stdcopy.StdCopy and ReadFile streamed via unbounded cat, allowing runaway container output or large/device files (e.g. /dev/zero) to exhaust host RAM (OOM).

replaceTrafficTokenIfMatchScript patched traffic_access_token in raw JSON using non-escape-aware Lua pattern matching (".-"), corrupting stored session binding JSON in Redis when the existing token contained escaped quotes/backslashes or when another string field contained a lookalike substring.

SessionBoundManager.OpenSessionTerminal did not validate non-empty opts.Cwd through workspace.CleanWorkDirIn / cleanSessionWorkDir before admitUser and prepareSessionDirs (mkdir -p), permitting relative or uncleaned working directories.

invariants_checked: Redis ZSET lease admission atomically rejects new holds when the closed barrier key exists, prunes expired members via Redis server TIME, and never shortens ZSET PTTL below longer-lived active leases.
Local deadline timers subtract renewMargin (ttl/6) from request send time so unconfirmed leases and barriers fail closed (ErrLeaseLost) before server-side expiry.
RedisRegistry.Close defaults non-positive TTLs to DefaultHoldTTL consistently with Hold and MemoryRegistry.Close.
Barrier.Seal atomically verifies caller lock-token ownership in Lua before PERSIST, preventing a stale/expired barrier from stripping a replacement barrier's TTL or silently succeeding after expiry.
Zero weknora/wk_ residues; key prefix conventions align with genyee:sandbox:*.

findings.summary: RedisRegistry.Close failed when passed ttl <= 0 instead of defaulting to DefaultHoldTTL (unlike Hold and MemoryRegistry.Close), and Barrier.Seal executed bare PERSIST without verifying the barrier's lock token, allowing an expired barrier to strip a replacement barrier's TTL or fail to report ErrLeaseLost when its key had already expired.

invariants_checked: UserMachine identity validation requires non-empty owner/config fields, rejects control characters and braces, and computes collision-resistant domain-separated digests.
Canonical UUID validation guards session IDs across memory, Postgres, and Redis caching layers.

Postgres store uses parameterized queries, transactional row locking / ON CONFLICT upserts, and clean rollback on partial failure; Redis read-through cache invalidates deterministically on release and config drop.
Concurrency safety verified under -race; zero weknora/wk_ residues.
Embedded desktop lifecycle scripts use static shell templates with strict numeric/allowlist validation and zero untrusted argument interpolation.
Desktop listeners bind to loopback / container-local ports as designed and use GENYEE paths (/var/lib/genyee, gy-display) with zero weknora/wk_ residues.

Lexical path resolution (ResolvePathIn, CleanWriteFileIn, CleanInputPathIn, CleanWorkDirIn, ValidOutputDirIn, RunnableScriptIn) normalizes paths via path.Clean, rejects non-absolute work dirs, and blocks writes to read-only session input trees including sibling sessions on shared machines.
UserSession requires canonical lowercase UUIDs before deriving deterministic 12-hex SHA-256 directory names, preventing path traversal via session IDs.
PromptSafePath rejects control characters, DEL, and angle/ampersand characters (<, >, &) to prevent prompt markup injection.
All fixed paths (/workspace, /var/lib/genyee/*, /opt/genyee/tenant/skills) follow GENYEE naming with zero weknora/wk_ residues.
